title: AI Engineer
summary: Designs, trains and deploys machine learning systems that learn from data, and makes sure they are safe and fair.

steps.title: Learn to program in Python
steps.description: Python is the main language of AI. Practise variables, loops, functions and debugging by solving many small problems.

steps.title: Understand what AI can and cannot do
steps.description: Learn the core ideas behind AI, where it works well, where it fails, and how it affects people, before writing AI code.

steps.title: Build the math foundations
steps.description: Machine learning relies on probability, statistics and linear algebra. Use visual tools first, then work through matrix and vector problems.

steps.title: Train your first machine learning models
steps.description: Learn how models learn from data, how to measure their accuracy, and how to avoid overfitting, using guided Python projects.

steps.title: Explore deep learning and language models
steps.description: Train neural networks for images and text, then learn how modern language models are built, fine-tuned and shared.

steps.title: Design AI responsibly
steps.description: Study fairness, transparency and accountability, and how organizations assess and reduce the risks of AI systems.

title: Data Scientist
summary: Collects, cleans and analyzes data to answer questions and make predictions in fields from health to the environment.

steps.title: Learn Python for working with data
steps.description: Learn Python basics, including lists, dictionaries, files and functions, so you can load and process data on your own.

steps.title: Learn statistics and probability
steps.description: Understand distributions, sampling, inference and regression, the tools for deciding what data really shows.

steps.title: Clean, analyze and visualize data
steps.description: Use pandas to load real survey data, fix messy values, combine tables and make clear charts.

steps.title: Build predictive models
steps.description: Train and evaluate models with scikit-learn, compare them with cross-validation, and avoid data leakage.

steps.title: Track and share your work
steps.description: Use Git to save versions of your analysis, collaborate with others and publish projects for a portfolio.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
summary: Protects people and organizations by finding weaknesses, monitoring for attacks and responding to security incidents.

steps.title: Learn security fundamentals
steps.description: Learn how accounts, data, systems and software are attacked and defended, and how to weigh risks and trade-offs.

steps.title: Get comfortable with the command line
steps.description: Analysts work in terminals every day. Practise navigating files, searching text and using shell tools through guided levels.

steps.title: Learn programming and how computers work
steps.description: Understanding code and how the web works helps you spot vulnerabilities and automate security tasks.

steps.title: Practise with capture-the-flag challenges
steps.description: Solve beginner challenges in cryptography, forensics and web security, then follow guided learning paths.

steps.title: Understand web application risks
steps.description: Learn how websites are built, then study the most common web vulnerabilities and how developers prevent them.

steps.title: Learn how organizations manage cyber risk
steps.description: Explore how organizations identify, protect, detect, respond to and recover from security incidents.

title: Robotics Engineer
summary: Designs, builds and programs robots that sense their surroundings and move, from factory arms to planetary rovers.

steps.title: Learn to program in Python
steps.description: Robots run on software. Learn Python basics, testing and debugging, which you will use to control and simulate robots.

steps.title: Understand circuits and electronics
steps.description: Learn voltage, current and resistance, then semiconductors and digital logic, the building blocks of sensors and motor controllers.

steps.title: Learn the math of motion
steps.description: Vectors and matrices describe where a robot is and how it moves. Build these linear algebra skills step by step.

steps.title: Study robot mechanisms and control
steps.description: Learn how robot arms and wheels are designed, how kinematics and dynamics work, and how controllers keep motion accurate.

steps.title: Plan robot motion
steps.description: Learn how robots plan collision-free paths and move wheeled bases and manipulators, using free video lectures and code.

steps.title: Add intelligence with AI
steps.description: Use search, optimization and machine learning so robots can make decisions and recognize what they sense.

title: Software Engineer
summary: Designs, builds, tests and maintains the apps, websites and systems that people use every day.

steps.title: Learn computer science fundamentals
steps.description: Learn how programs, algorithms and data structures work while writing code in several languages.

steps.title: Build websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
steps.description: Create real web pages and apps, from layout and styling to interactivity and accessibility, through guided projects.

steps.title: Master your developer tools
steps.description: Use the command line, editors, debuggers and Git confidently so you can work efficiently and collaborate.

steps.title: Write tested, reliable code
steps.description: Write unit tests, handle errors and organize code into modules so your programs keep working as they grow.

steps.title: Build secure software
steps.description: Learn the most common security mistakes in web applications and how to design code that avoids them.

steps.title: Learn how teams build software at scale
steps.description: Explore code review, testing culture, documentation and dependency management used by large engineering teams.

title: Environmental Scientist
summary: Studies air, water, land and living things to understand environmental change and protect ecosystems and human health.

steps.title: Learn how ecosystems work
steps.description: Study how living things interact with each other and their environment, and how human activity changes ecosystems.

steps.title: Observe nature and collect field data
steps.description: Record plants, animals and environmental measurements using shared scientific protocols, and contribute to real research datasets.

steps.title: Learn statistics for science
steps.description: Learn to summarize measurements, compare groups and test whether a pattern in your data is meaningful.

steps.title: Analyze environmental data with Python
steps.description: Use Python and pandas to clean, combine and plot real ecological survey data.

steps.title: See Earth from space with satellite data
steps.description: Learn how satellites measure land, oceans and air, and explore images that show environmental change over time.
